textos.Lançado em 1974 e dirigido por Roman Pol: Released in 1974 and directed by Roman Polanski, Chinatown is a mystery, crime and thriller film. In the plot, private detective Jake Gittes is hired by a socialite to investigate an extramarital affair, ending up caught in a complex web of personal and political scandals marked by deceit and falsehood.
textos.A narrativa adota um ritmo deliberadamen: The narrative adopts a deliberately slow, measured pace, relying on a dense atmosphere of investigation and a detailed period visual aesthetic.
textos.Os diferentes perfis de recepção concord: The different reception profiles agree on the nature of the work's central elements, but diverge sharply in their verdict on how well it works. Among the vast majority of ratings (~90%), many highlight Jack Nicholson's charismatic, striking performance. In addition, a good portion emphasizes the portrayal of entrenched corruption and abuse of power by the powerful, while a significant share praises the cinematography and the visual aesthetic that recreates the historical setting.
textos.Numa perspectiva intermediária, presente: From an intermediate perspective, present in a minimal fraction of ratings (~8%), the slow pace causes fatigue for several reviewers, who point to the dragging handling of the story. Even so, a considerable number retain praise for Jack Nicholson's performance as the work's mainstay, and many stress the technical quality and the aesthetics of the costumes and setting.
textos.Já sob o ponto de vista de quem reprovou: From the standpoint of those who rejected the film, who make up an even smaller fraction of ratings (~2%), a good portion criticize the excessive slowness and the monotonous nature of the pacing. For a significant share of this band, the association with the director's actions and personal history harms the experience, while several consider the script confusing, weak and hardly credible.
